description:
One variable in full: names, unit, which dataset, its coverage, how its
    quality flag is read, licence and DOI.  For a multi-dimensional variable
    read through zarr (access 'zarr'), its axes with their labels, the slice
    /query serves (prescribed) and an xarray line for any other slice.
name: describe_variable

access.description: query: estimate/get_data/aggregate serve it; zarr: a multi-dimensional variable (e.g. the ONEFlux NEE cube) read with xarray -- see zarr_recipe, and `prescribed` for its /query slice
access.title: Access

axes.description: zarr variables: each extra axis and its labels
axes.title: Axes

cf_standard_name.description: the CF standard name, given only for an exact match
cf_standard_name.title: Cf Standard Name

ecv.description: the GCOS Essential Climate Variable this observation contributes to; ICOS provides the observation, not the ECV product
ecv.title: Ecv

ecv_relation.description: 'related' when the variable is outside the ECV's own variable set (NEE to the greenhouse-gas ECV)
ecv_relation.title: Ecv Relation

ecv_role.description: observation, or derived and how (gap-filled, partitioned, aggregated)
ecv_role.title: Ecv Role

prescribed.description: zarr variables: the id of the preferred slice /query serves
prescribed.title: Prescribed

quality_control.description: how the store's QC flag is read; apply_qc=true applies the recommended rule
quality_control.title: Quality Control

query_kind.description: station_time (series at stations), obs_table (ship/cruise observations) or grid (gridded product)
query_kind.title: Query Kind

units_also_as.description: the same quantity in other communities' units: multiply by factor (e.g. umol CO2 m-2 s-1 to gC m-2 d-1 or t CO2 km-2 yr-1)
units_also_as.title: Units Also As

variants.description: the multi-dimensional variables this one is the PRESCRIBED slice of; their other slices are read through zarr (describe_variable on one gives the recipe)
variants.title: Variants

vocabulary_issues.description: a gap or an error in CF or in the ECV vocabulary for this variable -- read it before comparing with a CF-named field elsewhere
vocabulary_issues.title: Vocabulary Issues

vocabulary_mappings.description: SKOS mappings to NVS terms: the CF standard name (P07) as exactMatch or closeMatch with the conversion from this variable's units (factor, offset, to_units; a factor of -1 x ... is a sign flip), and the ECV (EXV) it contributes to
vocabulary_mappings.title: Vocabulary Mappings
